sourceFacts.signature: Sorted set of (selector basename, effect asset basename, effect class, effect scalar operands) reached from the attachment's progression(s) through the weapon's ability branches, WB modifier lists and GS bindings. Normalisation: Attachment_<Name>_<SLOT>_<Att> to <SLOT>_<Att>; case, '_' and '-' folded so spelling variants merge.
sourceFacts.uncapturedModifierAssets: WB modifier assets in the game catalog but not in this raw capture (effects behind them cannot be read; selectors bound only by them are coverage gaps, not findings): _RightRail/Light/WPM_RGT_Flashlight02_W15 (62 weapon WBs), _Attachments/Offset/RedDot/WM_SCA_OffsetRedDot (60), _Attachments/Canted/RedDot/WPM_SCP_CantedRedDot (55), _Barrel/WPM_BRL_Extended_W15 (55), _Attachments/Canted/RedDot/WPM_SCP_CantedRedDot_LongEyeRelief (4), _Ammo/_Shotgun/Buckshot/WPM_AMO_Buckshot_W10 (4), _Magazine/ExtendedMagazine/WPM_MAG_200Ext1_556_W55 (2). Selectors left unbound for these gaps: U_WPM_BRL_Extended_W15 (40 weapons), RGT/LFT SF300, MAG Extended1 on MG4K and Minimi, AMO Buckshot on all four shotguns.
sourceFacts.section3a: Attachments whose progression has no ability branch at all (11): G3A4 (AK4D) BRL_LightBarrel; SCARL (SOR-556 Mk2) MZL_M4QDFlashHider; M2010ESR MZL_Muzzle; M60E6 (M/60) ERG_Improved_Mag_Catch; DP12 (DB-12) BTM_CMR201, BTM_HolosunRMLt, BTM_LMDPEIR1, BTM_Perst1, BTM_SFX300, BTM_SFX400, BTM_X5LG3.
sourceFacts.section3b: Selectors unlocked by the attachment but bound by no WB modifier and no GS binding on that weapon, not a capture gap (6): HK433 (M433) ERG_MatchTrigger -> U_WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15; M27IAR (DRS-IAR) BTM_ZenitcoRK2 -> U_WPM_BTM_Vertical03_W20; RPK74M (RPK-74M) MAG_Compact1 -> U_WPM_MAG_030Cpt1_RPKM_W05 and MAG_Compact2 -> U_WPM_MAG_030Cpt2_RPKM_W10; RagingHunter (M44) ERG_MatchTrigger -> U_WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15; PP19 (PP-19) MAG_Compact1 -> U_WPM_MAG_025Cpt1_UMP40_W05.
sourceFacts.section3c: Whole effect missing or extra against 10+ agreeing weapons (a table of the strongest outliers, for example SCP_Iron_Sights extra WM_PlaceHolder_IronSights classes on PP19, MAG_Regular extra WPM_MAG_Std classes on CDX40 (ELR-40), AMO_Frangible extra WME_Penetration on MG5 (M121 A2) and M45A1). Detection is on a coarse key (effect class + asset name with step suffix), so tier changes (P10 vs P20, recoil +2 vs +3) are not counted; known by-design per-weapon rules (recoil step magnitudes by class, bolt-action *_Bolt assets) are not listed as strong.
sourceFacts.section3d: Weaker substitutions (16 rows): bolt-action rifles use the *_Bolt recoil and bipod assets in place of the generic ones (for example BTM_AtlasV8 on M2010ESR and MRAD (PSR): GRM_BipodDeployed_Bolt_BTM instead of GRM_BipodDeployed_BTM; muzzles on MiniFix, L115A3, MRAD, M2010ESR: GRM_Recoil_MZL_Bolt / GRM_SmoothRecoilBolt), AMO_Subsonic variants on HK417A2 and P90 use WPM_AMO_Subsonic* in place of WME_MuzzleVelocity, RGT_ANPEQ16B on DP12 uses WPM_RGT_LightLaser.
sourceFacts.section3e: Four rows suppressed as coverage gaps: MAG_Extended1 on MG4K (M123K) and Minimi (L110) (extra GS:GID_ADSTime_MAG; missing WPM_MAG_#Ext#).
sourceFacts.section2: Per-attachment majority signature and differing weapons, sorted by the number of weapons sharing the name (for example SCP_Iron_Sights/SCP_IronSights: 68 weapons, majority 3, 66 distinct signatures). The full per-row list is in the sibling CSV attachment-wiring-survey-2026-10-17-outliers.csv (1,953 rows: name, weaponsWithName, majorityCount, weapon, label, attachmentFile, type, majority, weaponItem, detail).

inference: The note is facts only and draws no balance conclusion; it is the starting list that the site's attachment wiring check script (scripts/frosty-attachment-wiring-check.py, commit 5045409) and the later attachment bug entries triage.
unresolved: Seven WB modifier assets are not in any 2.1.1.0 capture folder (listed above); selectors bound only by them cannot be read, including U_WPM_BRL_Extended_W15 on 40 weapons.
The coarse key does not count tier-level differences, so same-class operand differences are only in the CSV detail column.
A signature match shows serialized wiring, not that the effect is active at runtime.
siteImpact: None applied directly. The survey fed attachment bug entries 25 and 26 (deployed-bipod and semi-auto spread bindings missing; commit ec30b0b) and the wiring check script and its triage (commit 5045409); no data value was changed from it.
